protocol.scope: prespecified applicability & failure map of production GeoP2E under mesh-fitted primitives — NOT a superiority or native-B-Rep-generality claim
protocol.units: Cranfield metres; p2m reported in mm; inlier threshold 10mm (repo voxel 0.01m)
protocol.gt: benchmark ICP-refined estimates; direction VALIDATED per scan (declared vs inverse, recorded); symmetry solution set used when provided
protocol.secondary_arm: GeoP2E+ICP predeclared as basin-diagnostic only, never a rescue
protocol.canonical_inputs: per-part CAD sample + per-scan preprocessed source + per-scan FGR persisted under artifacts/cranfield_canon/
protocol.disclosure: evaluated under research use; no redistribution (repo has no LICENSE)

rpmnet_meta.note: zero-shot, partial_0.7_noisy checkpoint, own-centroid + target-extent normalisation, fixed-1024 seeded subsample
